AV1 · Game single | When a first- or second-string player on one side of the ball is Out or moved to Reserve/Injured and the replacement crosses a declared threshold, test whether the origination line should move more than the market did. | Injury report, reserve list, club roster status, prior season team and player statistics | Remove the replacement-quality term and re-run; a signal that survives without it is a name-recognition effect, not a deficiency effect. | Unvalidated | Official inputs / proposalNFL ↗ · NFL ↗ · NFL ↗

AV2 · Player prop | An unavailable primary target redistributes volume to the next receiver or the tight end; price the redistribution, not the missing player. | Injury report, depth ordering, receiving statistics | Exposure-only baseline: project the replacement from snap-free counting share alone and compare. | Unvalidated | Official inputs / proposalNFL ↗ · New England Patriots (club site) ↗ · NFL ↗

AV3 · Game single | Quarterback differential: the starter is Out and the replacement has fewer than a declared number of prior career pass attempts. | Injury report, reserve list, passing statistics by season | Split by home or away and by rest days; a uniform effect across splits is a market-overreaction claim, a split-only effect needs a predeclared interaction. | Unvalidated | Official inputs / proposalNFL ↗ · NFL ↗

AV4 · Feature, not a bet | Practice trajectory over the week predicts game availability, which is an input to any availability signal rather than a tradable edge. | Daily participation reports and the final status list | Test whether trajectory adds anything to the published status label; if not, drop it. | Unvalidated | Official definitions / proposalNFL ↗ · NFL ↗

AV5 · Game single | Line-cascade detector: two or more unavailable players at the same position, or one player occupying two depth slots. | Injury report, club roster, club depth ordering | Hold out the cascade term and test whether the single-absence effect already explains the movement. | Unvalidated | Official inputs / proposalNFL ↗ · NFL ↗ · New England Patriots (club site) ↗

AV6 · Filter | Separate managed rest from genuine limitation: full participation with no status label, versus limited all week with the same label. | Participation report and status definitions | Publish the abstention count the filter causes; a filter that only reduces sample size is not a signal. | Unvalidated | Official definitions / proposalNFL ↗ · NFL ↗

Two-leg joint price | P(A∩B)=p×q+rho×sqrt(p(1−p)q(1−q)); require max(0,p+q−1) ≤ joint ≤ min(p,q). | Algebra and feasibility checks tested | Project Bernoulli algebraOwn9 repository (primary project record) ↗

Decision gate | A Fisher-z interval is formed on the paired outcome. Only a verdict whose whole interval clears a predeclared deadband may enter a joint price; any other verdict returns no price at all. | Implemented and unit-tested on synthetic data | Formula support / project implementationSciPy project ↗ · Own9 repository (primary project record) ↗

Why not independence | Multiplying marginals asserts rho = 0. The gate exists so that a blank joint price is a true statement about missing evidence rather than a confident wrong number. | Policy implemented in engine/core.py | Project policyOwn9 repository (primary project record) ↗

Three or more legs | Pairwise correlations do not determine the full joint distribution. Need joint simulation or direct joint-event estimation and validation. | Not implemented | Project mathematical limitationOwn9 repository (primary project record) ↗
